_rulescope_notes: Created with POST /api/alerting/rule/rulescope-lag-miss-rate. Keys starting with _rulescope are removed before sending.
To change the threshold, edit the final WHERE (1.0 = 1%).
Confirmed on 9.5.6: Kibana accepts this .es-query ES|QL params shape (esqlQuery, timeField, timeWindowSize/Unit, threshold [0] with ">").
name: Ingest Lag Profiler: rule miss rate above 1%

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM rulescope-lag-results
| WHERE rulescope.window.start == DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, NOW()) - 1 hour
| STATS events = SUM(events), est_missed = SUM(est_missed),
        recommended_lookback_s = MAX(recommended_lookback_s)
     BY rulescope.space.id, rulescope.rule.id, rulescope.rule.name, rulescope.rule.lookback_s
| EVAL miss_rate_pct = ROUND(est_missed / events * 100, 2)
| WHERE miss_rate_pct > 1.0
| SORT miss_rate_pct DESC
| LIMIT 100
